data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek word 'gantos', meaning 'pleaser' or 'rewarder'. In the New Testament, Gant is not mentioned as a name, but it carries a strong and firm meaning in the Christian context, symbolizing dedication, loyalty, and commitment. The name Gant carries the meaning “Strong, Firm” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Gant usually hope their child will grow to embody strong, firm and live with faith, good character and purpose.
